name: Timeline simulator default scenario matches golden totals
description: Verify the timeline simulator loads the default scenario and shows the golden match badge with expected invoice totals.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page and click 'Simulator' in the top navigation bar, without choosing a scenario
Assert the 'Load scenario' dropdown shows S05 and the '✅ Matches golden expected' badge is shown
Assert Invoice 1 totals $29.00 and Invoice 2 totals $103.20
